newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares end down on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares end down on profit taking.

text.p: Jakarta share prices ended lower on continued profit taking on Tuesday amid weak market sentiment as brokers wound down ahead of the Christmas holiday, brokers said.

The Jakarta Composite Index was down 0.33 points, or 0.05 percent, to close at 632.74 points. Gainers led losers by 65 to 41, with 57 counters unchanged. "Overall trading was dull as many brokers were just looking forward to closing time," one said.
The market is expected to move in a tight-range on Thursday when it resumes trading following the Christmas holiday on Wednesday, brokers said.
